title.zh: 李建江老师指导的中海油服科技服务团获评“优秀团队”
title.en: COSL service team advised by Professor Li recognized as an outstanding team

summary.zh: 学院报道：在 2025 年研究生科技服务与挂职锻炼总结评优中，中海油服科技服务团获得“优秀团队”荣誉。
summary.en: The school reported that the COSL service team received an outstanding team award in the university’s 2025 graduate technology service and placement review.

body.zh: 公开报道列示指导教师为李建江、队长为李亿行。团队围绕测井业务数字化，开展数据采集与三维可视化、RAG 知识服务及日志实时传输等实践。该报道不构成完整的课题组成员名单。
body.en: The report names Jianjiang Li as faculty adviser and 李亿行 as team leader. The team worked on logging-data acquisition and 3D visualization, a RAG knowledge service, and real-time log transmission. The report does not establish a complete group roster.
